announcements.headline: Results of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: The AGM results confirm proceedings following the September dividend payments and October board changes. Shareholders should monitor for further governance updates.

announcements.headline: Senior Management and Board Changes
announcements.insight: Board changes follow recent interim results and special dividends. Shareholders should monitor how this governance shift impacts future capital returns.

announcements.headline: Special Dividend – GBP Dividend Rate
announcements.insight: Asiamet Resources Limited declares a special dividend following its September sale of Indokal Limited. Shareholders should monitor the payment instructions and exchange rate details for execution.

announcements.headline: Interim Results for Six Months Ended 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: The sale of Indokal Limited is finalized, triggering a special dividend. Shareholders should monitor the GBP/USD exchange rate details for payment instructions.

announcements.headline: Special Dividend – GBP/USD Exchange Rate
announcements.insight: Asiamet Resources Limited confirms a special dividend following the sale of Indokal Limited in September. Shareholders should await payment instructions issued later that month.

announcements.headline: Special Dividend – Payment Instructions
announcements.insight: Following the September sale of Indokal, payment instructions for the associated special dividend are now issued. This finalizes the financial settlement for shareholders from that disposal.

announcements.headline: Long Term Incentive Programme
announcements.insight: Asiamet Resources Limited announces a Long Term Incentive Programme. This follows updates on the Indokal sale in May, August and September.

announcements.headline: Sale of Indokal Limited and Special Dividend
announcements.insight: Following updates in August and September, the sale of Indokal Limited is complete, triggering a special dividend for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Update on Sale of Indokal Limited (KSK Project)
announcements.insight: Asiamet Resources provides a further update on the proposed sale of Indokal, following its August announcement. Shareholders should monitor for completion details or changes to the transaction terms.

announcements.headline: Update on Proposed Sale of Indokal (KSK Project)
announcements.insight: Asiamet Resources Limited provides an update on the proposed sale of its Indokal (KSK Project), following the 2025 Annual Report. Shareholders should monitor progress on this potential disposal.

announcements.headline: 2025 Annual Report & Financial Statements
announcements.insight: Asiamet Resources Limited has published its 2025 Annual Report & Financial Statements. Shareholders should review the filing for performance details.
